title: Learning Graph Viewer
description: Interactive vis-network visualization of the learning graph for the Clocks and Watches with MicroPython course, showing concept dependencies and learning pathways.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Learning Graph
Knowledge Visualization
Course Planning
Concept Dependencies
learningObjectives: Identify the major concept areas in the Clocks and Watches with MicroPython learning graph
Trace prerequisite chains from foundational concepts to advanced topics by following the graph's directed edges
Plan a learning path that satisfies every prerequisite before reaching a chosen target concept
Analyze which concepts have the most prerequisites or dependents by clicking nodes to highlight their connections
